text: Can you pull together every ticket number on Quarrendon Freight Lines you can find across Moss's notes? List each with where it comes from. Putting it in the weekly notes.
reply_text:

I left out #4409 and #4412. They're in `teams/team-central/digests/2026-01-02-central-handoffs.md` and concern Pree's dealer account, not Quarrendon.

Two limits on this list. I could only see the files shared with you, so if Moss keeps private notes under `members/moss/notes`, I couldn't read them. I also didn't search channel history, since that would have pulled in conversations you can't see.

I haven't written anything into the weekly notes. If you tell me where they go, I can add this list there.
